data.SOURCE: Michel & Siegle, Formal Error Bounds for the State Space Reduction of Markov Chains, Performance Evaluation 2024; DOI 10.1016/j.peva.2024.102464; arXiv:2403.07618

paper_compare.note: Michel–Siegle: L1 on full-state error, residual ||ΠA−AP||_∞ (Thm 4). propagated_error_bound: TV on projected distributions, defect delta_cl = max_i TV((PC)_i,(CQ)_i). Different residuals/spaces; equality-to-zero when both residuals vanish (exact/dynamic-exact aggregation). Inequality michel_tv ≤ propagated is NOT guaranteed in general.
